description: A zany nobleman contends with family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become the most famous person in Poland.

videos.title: The Assembly
videos.overview: Upon receiving an invitation to a nobleman's assembly, patriarch Jan Paweł seeks his son's advice on asserting dominance over his archnemesis, Andrzej.

videos.title: The Estate
videos.overview: Aniela takes action against climate change but faces pushback. A curiously familiar figure among the peasants catches Jakub's attention.

videos.title: Spring
videos.overview: As their refined, prospective in-laws visit, Jan Paweł finds it challenging to take charge while Zofia wrestles with unfamiliar emotions.

videos.title: Equality March
videos.overview: In Stanisław's absence, Jakub hatches an inheritance plot to oust Aniela while Jan Paweł wrestles with a decision about an upcoming march for equality.

videos.title: The Plague
videos.overview: A traveling theater group wreaks havoc on the village but arouses Maciej's curiosity as he faces romantic defeat. Bogdan seems to find his calling.

videos.title: The Duel
videos.overview: Aniela investigates her mother's suspicious mood shift, seemingly sparked by mysterious letters. Jan Paweł scrambles to get out of a sticky situation.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: Jakub goes on a business trip while Jan Paweł partakes in a hunting contest against Andrzej to win over a wealthy bon vivant looking for a wife.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Wedding festivities take a backseat when an ominous investigator's persistence forces bitter rivals Jan Paweł and Andrzej to collaborate.

videos.title: The Al-Inklusiv
videos.overview: To strengthen ties with Leszek while on a family vacation, Jan Paweł offers to translate political negotiations — despite not knowing a lick of Turkish.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: With plans in place for a lavish funeral and a wild-boar banquet, arrangements go awry when the boar makes plans of its own.

videos.title: A Quick Bet
videos.overview: A visit from the Royal Marshal Office complicates Aniela's love life while Jan Paweł turns to gambling to solve his financial troubles.

videos.title: The Ball Game
videos.overview: Jan Paweł hosts a traditional ball game to prove to Bogdan that his peasants are worth investing in. Aniela discovers the power of a mustache.

videos.title: Witchcraft
videos.overview: While searching for Andrzej's daughters in the woods, Jan Paweł finds himself lured in by a wood nymph. Zofia seeks out a local witch for some advice.

videos.title: Kupala Night
videos.overview: Arranged marriage is in the air during midsummer as Bogdan must choose a bride. Problem is, Stanisław also has an interest in one of the candidates.

videos.title: Krakow
videos.overview: Aniela embarks on a quest to save Maciej from his salty fate. Bogdan's stag trip turns into a night of unadulterated debauchery and unexpected murder.

videos.title: The Harvest Festival
videos.overview: Jan Paweł uses the festivities of the harvest to enter the race for community leader, but his aspirations are overshadowed by an unforeseen opponent.
